rows.text: The library will close at 4 p.m. on Friday while electricians replace the lights. Holds that expire on Friday can be collected on Saturday.
rows.reason: A public notice gives the change, reason, and practical consequence directly.

rows.text: Toast the cumin in a dry pan until it smells nutty, about thirty seconds. Tip it into a bowl before adding the oil to the pan.
rows.reason: Sensory language gives a useful cooking cue and the instructions remain concrete.

rows.text: Hi Mara, I found the missing invoices in the archive folder. Two are unsigned; I marked those in the spreadsheet so you can check them before Friday.
rows.reason: The greeting belongs to the email genre, and the rest reports specific work.

rows.text: This cup was repaired with three metal staples. The holes beside the crack show where the restorer drilled through the clay.
rows.reason: Passive voice and an inference tied to visible evidence are appropriate to an object label.

rows.text: I liked the first half of the novel more than the ending. Once the narrator left the farm, I missed the arguments with her sister.
rows.reason: A subjective opinion is grounded in the reviewer’s stated experience rather than inflated into universal judgment.

rows.text: Version 4 rejects files with duplicate column names. Earlier versions kept the final occurrence and discarded the others without a warning.
rows.reason: The version comparison describes a concrete behavior change.

rows.text: We excluded four trials because the camera stopped before the final measurement. The remaining 36 trials included observations from all six animals.
rows.reason: The methods passage identifies a specific exclusion rule and the resulting sample.

rows.text: The argument requires a finite graph. On an infinite graph, the sequence of distinct vertices need not contain a cycle.
rows.reason: The restriction and countercase serve the mathematical explanation.

rows.text: Median response time fell from 18 ms to 13 ms after the index was added. The benchmark used the same 40 queries and a warm cache in both runs.
rows.reason: The result supplies a comparison and enough context to interpret its scope.

rows.text: The brochure describes the scanner as "a game-changing leap into tomorrow." Replace that claim with its scan resolution and supported paper sizes.
rows.reason: The promotional phrase is quoted as an object of criticism, not used as the author’s own claim.

rows.text: Together, we can weave a brighter tapestry of hope, empowering communities and fostering transformative change as we embark on this extraordinary journey toward a better tomorrow.
rows.reason: A fundraising appeal consists of grand abstractions and stock metaphors without identifying an action or beneficiary.

findings.title: Generic upbeat ending
findings.question: Does the passage end with an upbeat formula such as the future looks bright, exciting times lie ahead, or a journey toward excellence that adds no concrete next step or conclusion?
findings.guidance: End on the last substantive claim or an already-supported next step.

findings.title: Generic step-forward claim
findings.question: Does a step forward or a step toward framing praise progress without saying what capability or outcome actually changed?
findings.guidance: State the concrete change, or remove the progress framing.

rows.text: Nestled in the heart of an enchanting region, our village boasts a rich tapestry of experiences, seamlessly blending timeless charm with vibrant modern energy. There truly is something for everyone.
rows.reason: The travel description stacks generic promotional phrases instead of describing the place.

findings.title: Empty intensifiers
findings.question: Does a word such as truly, genuinely, incredibly, or very amplify praise without contributing a specific degree or meaningful contrast?
findings.guidance: Remove the intensifier if the underlying claim keeps its meaning.

findings.title: Brochure-like description
findings.question: Does otherwise informative prose describe a place or product with stacked promotional praise such as breathtaking, vibrant, renowned, or must-visit instead of relevant descriptive facts?
findings.guidance: Use the supported description and preserve any explicitly requested advertising voice.

findings.title: Unsupported symbolic gloss

rows.text: Our café is not about coffee. It is about connection. Not about sandwiches, but about stories. Not about lunch, but about limitless possibility.
rows.reason: Repeated negative parallelism replaces information with vague promotional abstractions.

rows.text: Leading voices have praised the mayor’s announcement as visionary. Observers across the field agree that its far-reaching impact will be felt for decades, according to numerous reports.

findings.guidance: Identify the source if available; otherwise flag the missing attribution instead of manufacturing one.

findings.title: Unspecified improvement

findings.guidance: Describe the supported before-and-after behavior; retain uncertainty and do not invent measurements.
